sc_spell_salt_volley.name: Salt Volley
sc_spell_salt_volley.description: Deal 5 flat salt damage to an enemy within 3 of a friendly unit.

sc_spell_levy_summons.name: Levy Summons
sc_spell_levy_summons.description: Summon 1 Salt Levy on an empty tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

sc_spell_toll_gate.name: Toll Gate
sc_spell_toll_gate.description: Raise a salt wall for 3 turns on an empty tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

sc_spell_drill_order.name: Drill Order
sc_spell_drill_order.description: Allies in radius 1 of the target ally gain Emboldened for 2 turns.

sc_spell_caustic_mist.name: Caustic Mist
sc_spell_caustic_mist.description: Apply Caustic for 2 turns and deal 3 flat salt damage to enemies in radius 1 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

sc_spell_road_levy.name: Road Levy
sc_spell_road_levy.description: Deal 1 flat salt damage to an enemy within 3 of a friendly unit and gain 3 Tide.

sc_spell_salt_the_earth.name: Salt the Earth
sc_spell_salt_the_earth.description: Deal 4 flat salt damage and apply Rooted for 2 turns to enemies in radius 2 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

sc_spell_edict_of_assize.name: Edict of Assize
sc_spell_edict_of_assize.description: Drain 4 Tide from the enemy team and give Shielded for 2 turns to allies in radius 2 of a friendly unit within 3.

hc_spell_pressure_spike.name: Pressure Spike
hc_spell_pressure_spike.description: Deal 6 flat pressure damage to an enemy within 3 tiles of a friendly unit and apply Crushed for 1 turn.

hc_spell_lightless_veil.name: Lightless Veil
hc_spell_lightless_veil.description: Enemies within 1 tile of the target tile are Darkened for 2 turns.

hc_spell_vent_surge.name: Vent Surge
hc_spell_vent_surge.description: Heal an ally for 8 and apply Mending for 2 turns.

hc_spell_undertow.name: Undertow
hc_spell_undertow.description: Pull an enemy up to 3 tiles toward the nearest caster-side ally and apply Lured for 1 turn.

hc_spell_call_thralls.name: Call the Thralls
hc_spell_call_thralls.description: Summon 2 Pit Thralls on or near an empty tile within 3 tiles of a friendly unit.

hc_spell_bellward.name: Bellward
hc_spell_bellward.description: An ally is Shielded and Emboldened for 2 turns.

hc_spell_the_weight_returns.name: The Weight Returns
hc_spell_the_weight_returns.description: Enemies within 2 tiles of the target tile take 6 flat pressure damage, are Crushed for 2 turns, and the tile becomes a trench for 3 turns.

hc_spell_tithe_of_depths.name: Tithe of the Depths
hc_spell_tithe_of_depths.description: Drain 15 Tide from the enemy and gain 10 Tide.

rt_spell_brine_lash.name: Brine Lash
rt_spell_brine_lash.description: Deal 5 brine damage to an enemy within 3 of an ally and apply Soaked for 2 turns.

rt_spell_wet_blessing.name: Wet Blessing
rt_spell_wet_blessing.description: Heal an ally 6 and apply Mending for 2 turns.

rt_spell_pool_of_the_faithful.name: Pool of the Faithful
rt_spell_pool_of_the_faithful.description: Flood a radius-1 area near an ally into brine_pool for 3 turns.

rt_spell_wringing_rite.name: Wringing Rite
rt_spell_wringing_rite.description: Deal 4 brine damage to an enemy within 3 of an ally and gain 8 Tide.

rt_spell_drowned_rise.name: The Drowned Rise
rt_spell_drowned_rise.description: Raise 2 Drowned on or near an empty tile within 3 of an ally.

rt_spell_hymn_of_the_deep.name: Hymn of the Deep
rt_spell_hymn_of_the_deep.description: Allies in radius 2 of the target tile gain Hymned (+1 attack, +1 defense) for 3 turns.

rt_spell_the_sea_remembers.name: The Sea Remembers
rt_spell_the_sea_remembers.description: Anywhere on the map: flood a radius-2 area into brine_pool for 3 turns. Enemies inside take 4 brine damage and are Soaked for 2 turns.

rt_spell_tithe_of_water.name: Tithe of Water
rt_spell_tithe_of_water.description: Anywhere on the map: the target enemy takes Drowning for 3 turns, the enemy loses 12 Tide and you gain 12 Tide.

sv_spell_flash_fire.name: Flash Fire
sv_spell_flash_fire.description: Deal 4 flat fire damage to enemies within 1 tile of the target tile and apply Burning for 1 turn.

sv_spell_grease_the_deck.name: Grease the Deck
sv_spell_grease_the_deck.description: Tiles within 1 of the target tile become lamp oil for 3 turns.

sv_spell_cut_and_run_tonic.name: Cut-and-Run Tonic
sv_spell_cut_and_run_tonic.description: Heal an ally for 4 and apply Hasted for 1 turn.

sv_spell_tripwire_alley.name: Tripwire Alley
sv_spell_tripwire_alley.description: Enemies within 1 tile of the target tile are Rooted for 1 turn and Marked for 2 turns.

sv_spell_hired_knives.name: Hired Knives
sv_spell_hired_knives.description: Summon 2 Hull Scrappers on or near the target empty tile.

sv_spell_black_market_cut.name: Black Market Cut
sv_spell_black_market_cut.description: Drain 6 essence from the enemy and gain 3 essence.

sv_spell_powder_barrage.name: Powder Barrage
sv_spell_powder_barrage.description: Deal 6 flat fire damage to enemies within 2 tiles of the target tile and apply Burning for 2 turns.

sv_spell_compact_embargo.name: Compact Embargo
sv_spell_compact_embargo.description: Choose any enemy: it is Stunned for 1 turn and Marked for 2 turns.

ra_spell_swarm_call.name: Swarm Call
ra_spell_swarm_call.description: Summon 2 Polyp Drones on or near an empty tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

ra_spell_creeping_reef.name: Creeping Reef
ra_spell_creeping_reef.description: The target tile and tiles within 1 become living reef.

ra_spell_calcite_shard.name: Calcite Shard
ra_spell_calcite_shard.description: Deal 5 flat physical damage to an enemy.

ra_spell_consume_calcite.name: Consume Calcite
ra_spell_consume_calcite.description: Allies within 1 of the target tile heal 6 and gain Bloom for 3 turns. The tiles become living reef, consuming any calcite on them.

ra_spell_synapse_surge.name: Synapse Surge
ra_spell_synapse_surge.description: Allies within 2 of the target ally become Emboldened and Hasted for 1 turn.

ra_spell_choking_overgrowth.name: Choking Overgrowth
ra_spell_choking_overgrowth.description: Enemies within 1 of the target tile are Rooted and Soaked for 1 turn, and the tiles become living reef.

ra_spell_great_waking.name: The Great Waking
ra_spell_great_waking.description: Summon 4 Polyp Drones on or near an empty tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

ra_spell_tithe_of_the_shelf.name: Tithe of the Shelf
ra_spell_tithe_of_the_shelf.description: Deal 5 flat physical damage to any enemy, drain 10 enemy Tide and gain 10 Tide.

lk_spell_lamp_flash.name: Lamp Flash
lk_spell_lamp_flash.description: Deal 5 light damage to an enemy within 3 of a friendly unit and Mark it for 2 turns.

lk_spell_kindle_the_wick.name: Kindle the Wick
lk_spell_kindle_the_wick.description: Heal an ally within 3 tiles of the Beacon for 7 and give it Mending for 2 turns.

lk_spell_tithe_of_oil.name: Tithe of Oil
lk_spell_tithe_of_oil.description: Gain 20 Tide as the keepers tip a store of lamp oil into the cistern.

lk_spell_hooded_lamp.name: Hooded Lamp
lk_spell_hooded_lamp.description: Give allies in radius 1 of a unit within 3 tiles of the Beacon Shielded for 2 turns.

lk_spell_beam_of_the_long_watch.name: Beam of the Long Watch
lk_spell_beam_of_the_long_watch.description: Deal 7 light damage to enemies in radius 1 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit and Dazzle them for 2 turns.

lk_spell_call_the_drowned.name: Call the Drowned
lk_spell_call_the_drowned.description: Summon 2 Lamplit Sailors on an empty tile within 3 tiles of the Beacon.

lk_spell_dawn_over_the_shoal.name: Dawn over the Shoal
lk_spell_dawn_over_the_shoal.description: Deal 6 light damage to enemies in radius 2 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit and Mark them for 3 turns.

lk_spell_the_lamp_will_not_go_out.name: The Lamp Will Not Go Out
lk_spell_the_lamp_will_not_go_out.description: Heal allies in radius 3 of a tile within 3 of the Beacon for 8 and give them Shielded for 2 turns.

oc_spell_rain_of_fish.name: Rain of Fish
oc_spell_rain_of_fish.description: Summon 2 Bellyeye Shoals on an empty tile anywhere on the board.

oc_spell_brine_squall.name: Brine Squall
oc_spell_brine_squall.description: Turn the tiles within 1 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit into brine pool for 2 turns and apply Soaked to enemies there for 2 turns.

oc_spell_something_heavy.name: Something Heavy
oc_spell_something_heavy.description: Something falls out of the sky onto one enemy anywhere on the board: 6 physical damage.

oc_spell_ink_bloom.name: Ink Bloom
oc_spell_ink_bloom.description: Apply Inked (-2 attack, -1 defense) for 2 turns to enemies within 1 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

oc_spell_undertow_from_above.name: Undertow from Above
oc_spell_undertow_from_above.description: Pull every enemy within 2 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit 2 tiles toward that tile.

oc_spell_spawning_water.name: Spawning Water
oc_spell_spawning_water.description: Heal allies within 2 of a friendly unit for 3 and make them Wet for 3 turns.

oc_spell_the_sky_opens.name: The Sky Opens
oc_spell_the_sky_opens.description: Turn the tiles within 2 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit into brine pool for 3 turns and deal 3 brine damage to enemies there.

oc_spell_hunger.name: Hunger
oc_spell_hunger.description: Deal 2 physical damage to enemies within 3 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit, +5 to any below half HP.

gy_spell_carrion_call.name: Carrion Call
gy_spell_carrion_call.description: Summon 2 Salt Crows on an empty tile within 3 of a friendly unit.

gy_spell_updraft.name: Updraft
gy_spell_updraft.description: Give allies in radius 1 of a tile within 3 of a friendly unit Hasted for 1 turn.

gy_spell_dive_signal.name: Dive Signal
gy_spell_dive_signal.description: Mark an enemy within 4 of a friendly unit for 2 turns and apply Harried for 2 turns. Best cast with a flier nearby.

gy_spell_feather_squall.name: Feather Squall
gy_spell_feather_squall.description: Give enemies in radius 1 of a tile within 4 of a friendly unit Weakened for 2 turns.

gy_spell_wrong_sky_gale.name: Wrong-Sky Gale
gy_spell_wrong_sky_gale.description: Push enemies in radius 1 of a tile within 4 of a friendly unit 2 tiles away, dealing 2 damage if they hit something.

gy_spell_black_sky.name: Black Sky
gy_spell_black_sky.description: Deal 3 flat physical damage to enemies in radius 2 of a tile within 4 of a friendly unit.

gy_spell_the_wheel_turns.name: The Wheel Turns
gy_spell_the_wheel_turns.description: Give all allies Hasted for 2 turns.

gy_spell_picked_clean.name: Picked Clean
gy_spell_picked_clean.description: Deal 5 flat physical damage to an enemy within 5 of a friendly unit (+5 if it is below half HP).
